answer: Proof of Work creates Sybil resistance by anchoring digital identity to physical resource expenditure. An agent must process a yarrow of computational hashes to validate a block, effectively turning a simple signal of intent into a verifiable economic commitment. Without this rigorous expenditure, an attacker could spawn infinite identities, but the high cost of each virtual marble makes flooding the network financially unsustainable, ensuring that influence scales with capital rather than account count.
